ns2:course.label: Landscape Graphics & Design
ns2:course.description: Focuses on the development of graphic skills to represent the landscape, using both hand-drawn (pencil and color rendering) and introductory digital methods (e.g., AutoCAD and Photoshop). Students will learn basic principles for organizing space and designing for function, using plant materials that are appropriate for site conditions. A variety of drafting tools and access to specific design software programs are required. AutoCAD and Photoshop will be available for students to use in the classroom.
